page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8ae.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by dedicated AMD EPYC 9T34 processors running at 3.4 GHz. It features 32 physical cores and 32 vCPUs with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration, backed by KVM virtualization. The memory configuration consists of 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. This instance does not include local storage or GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and featuring a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong single-core capabilities, with stress-ng single-core CPU performance and Geekbench single-core scores both ranking in the top 25%. Geekbench multi-core performance and PassMark memory scores also place in the top 25%, while text processing benchmarks reach the top 10% tier. Multi-core stress-ng CPU performance, PassMark CPU scores, and memory bandwidth perform in the average middle 50% range. The processor supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512 and hardware-accelerated cryptography, which contributes to its strong performance in encryption benchmarks.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.r8ae.8xlarge offers high memory density per vCPU, making it a viable option for workloads that require substantial memory capacity without the overhead of excessive compute cores. Given the absence of local storage and GPUs, it is optimized for memory-intensive, network-dependent applications. Suitable workloads include in-memory databases, caching layers such as Redis, enterprise applications, text processing pipelines, and memory-heavy data processing tasks.
